items.title: Dangerous Escalation: US and Israel Strikes on Iran and Iran’s Retaliation Raise Fears of Wider War and Potential World War III. Give Peace a Chance. Choose Diplomacy Over War.
items.excerpt: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan warns that escalating military confrontation between the United States, Israel, and Iran risks triggering a wider regional conflict with global consequences.
items.author: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan

heroImage.caption: Escalating tensions in the Middle East following US and Israel strikes on Iran and Iran’s retaliation.
